thread:
maya: quick pulse — dropping the company-level OKR draft for the upcoming quarter. please skim and flag blockers. TL;DR:
- Obj A: Reduce inference cost per 1M tokens by 18% while keeping latency SLOs.
- Obj B: Launch Redwood Dedicated beta in eu-west with SLA + audit docs.
- Obj C: Improve model quality regressions detection (eval + alerts).

Key tradeoffs I'm calling out:
- aggressive batching/quantization can hit quality for small-chat workloads; will need canary sets.
- Dedicated launch needs 2 infra sprints for multi-region routing + KMS integration.

Asks:
1) Eng sign-off on infra timeline + fallback policies.
2) Finance confirmation on the planned spend buffer for Dedicated ramp.
3) GTM/PD on launch criteria and minimum customer cohort.

Link to draft: https://redwood.internal/okrs/q2-company-draft (comments enabled)

raj: looks good high-level. two quick ones: can we convert Obj B SLA into measurable latency p95 for 99.9% uptime? also want a proposed canary cadence for Dedicated launch.

derrick: infra notes — current estimate: need 2 dev weeks + 3 hardening weeks for multi-region routing. KV-cache cross-region replication is the wildcard. if we deprioritize cross-region cache at GA we can ship faster with documented fallback.

sophie: from eng-platform: will need feature flags + auto-fallback to hosted models for capacity emergencies. propose rollout plan:
- canary group: 5% traffic, 72h health window
- expand: 25% 1 week
- full: 2 weeks after no regressions

luis: finance — what's the expected incremental monthly burn at 5% traffic? need the number to size the committed capacity option. also, if Dedicated sells to 1 pilot customer, will that cover infra run rate?

maya: @luis good call. rough guesstimate: at 5% traffic across eu-west pool that's ~$30k/mo incremental (gpu + infra), 25% ~ $120k/mo. will tighten with eng on Monday.

oliver: high level: we should be comfortable with having a documented downgrade plan. if Dedicated GA risks pushing cost above forecast, we either delay or tighten launch scope (no cross-region cache at GA). prefer to get pilot customers in now — who are potential pilots?

raj: pilot candidates: AcmeAnalytics (high compliance), Finly (needs private deployment), and CloudForms (embedding-heavy). Acme is highest priority for SLA reasons.

derrick: operational risk note: we need an oncall ramp for Dedicated during first 6 weeks, suggest schedule overlap with Hosted SRE for first 2 weeks.

sophie: testing checklist I'll add to the doc today: perf benchmarks, regression evals, fallback exercises, canary rollout steps, incident runbook.

maya: next steps I propose:
- eng: lock timeline by Mon EOD (derrick + sophie)
- finance: commit buffer number by Tue noon (luis)
- exec: sign off on launch tolerance and canary plan by Wed EOD (raj + oliver)

okr-bot: reminder — OKR sign-off deadline in 4 days. Current sign-offs: maya, raj. Pending: derrick, sophie, luis, oliver.

raj: +1 to the proposed next steps. one more: please add a short bullet in launch criteria about minimum acceptable token-quality delta compared to hosted baseline (we shouldn't accept >2% drop in eval score).

maya: noted — adding that now. thanks all, please annotate the draft with concrete numbers where possible. will reconvene Wed morning for a final pass. :thumbsup:
